title: Broadcom Plunges 5% as Its AI Boom Faces a $370 Billion Financing Question
excerpt: Broadcom Inc. (NASDAQ:AVGO) traded down more than 5% Friday as a new estimate put an enormous number on the debt machine behind the chipmaker’s AI expansion....
content_html:

Broadcom Inc. (NASDAQ:AVGO) traded down more than 5% Friday as a new estimate put an enormous number on the debt machine behind the chipmaker's AI expansion.

BofA analyst Tom Curcuruto estimates Broadcom's chip-financing vehicle could reach $370 billion of senior debt by mid-2029 at a 20-gigawatt scale, including roughly $150 billion of new issuance in 2027 alone, Reuters reported Friday.

That does not mean Broadcom itself would owe $370 billion. The financing vehicle would raise the debt, but Broadcom has agreed to backstop some of the customer lease obligations.

Prediction market traders are betting Broadcom's AI business will deliver another huge quarter. The company generated $10.8 billion of AI semiconductor revenue last quarter and has guided to $16 billion for the current quarter.

Polymarket traders currently give Broadcom a 94% chance of topping $15 billion in AI revenue this quarter, and a 78% chance of exceeding $16 billion.

How a $35 Billion Anthropic Deal Became Broadcom's Problem Too

The structure began taking shape in June, when Apollo (NYSE:APO) and Blackstone (NYSE:BX) led a $35 billion financing for Broadcom's AI XPV Platform. The first deal will fund more than 1 gigawatt of compute capacity for Anthropic, while the broader platform is designed to support more than 20 gigawatts for frontier AI labs through 2028.

Instead of requiring AI customers to fund the entire upfront cost themselves, institutional investors finance the AI racks and lease them to the customers. But Broadcom is taking on some of the risk that makes that financing possible.

In its latest 10-Q, Broadcom disclosed that an investor partner assumed agreements to purchase racks containing its custom AI accelerators, along with the leases to the customer using them. Broadcom agreed to backstop those lease payments for five years, giving it maximum exposure of up to $29 billion on the initial transaction.

If a customer defaults, Broadcom can take over the lease or arrange a sale of the equipment, reducing whatever amount it ultimately has to cover.

Is Broadcom Financing Its Own AI Growth?

The financing structure could help Broadcom turn strong demand for AI chips into actual deployments by giving customers access to outside capital for the enormous upfront cost of new compute capacity.

But Broadcom is also taking on risk alongside those sales. Under the backstop arrangements it has disclosed, the company could be required to cover customer lease payments if a customer defaults.

博通公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AVGO）周五股价下跌超过 5%，因为新的估计表明该芯片制造商的人工智能扩张背后的债务机器庞大。

据路透社周五报道，美国银行分析师 Tom Curcuruto 估计，到 2029 年中期，博通的芯片融资工具可能会以 20 吉瓦的规模发行 3700 亿美元的高级债务，其中仅 2027 年就将发行约 1500 亿美元的新债券。

这并不意味着博通本身将欠下 3700 亿美元。 融资工具将增加债务，但博通已同意支持部分客户租赁义务。

预测市场交易员押注博通的人工智能业务将带来另一个巨大的季度业绩。 该公司上季度 AI 半导体收入为 108 亿美元，本季度预计收入为 160 亿美元。

Polymarket 交易员目前认为博通本季度人工智能收入突破 150 亿美元的可能性为 94%，超过 160 亿美元的可能性为 78%。

350 亿美元的人为交易如何也成为博通的问题

该结构于 6 月开始成形，当时 Apollo (NYSE:APO) 和 Blackstone (NYSE:BX) 为 Broadcom 的 AI XPV 平台提供了 350 亿美元的融资。 第一项交易将为 Anthropic 提供超过 1 吉瓦的计算能力，而更广泛的平台旨在到 2028 年为前沿人工智能实验室提供超过 20 吉瓦的计算能力。

机构投资者不再要求人工智能客户自己承担全部前期成本，而是为人工智能机架提供资金并将其租赁给客户。 但博通正在承担一些风险，使融资成为可能。

博通在最新的 10-Q 报告中披露，一家投资合作伙伴同意购买包含其定制人工智能加速器的机架，并向使用这些加速器的客户提供租赁服务。 Broadcom 同意在五年内支持这些租赁付款，使其在初始交易中的最大风险敞口高达 290 亿美元。

如果客户违约，博通可以接管租赁或安排出售设备，从而减少最终需要支付的金额。

博通是否为其自身的人工智能发展提供资金？

该融资结构可以帮助博通将人工智能芯片的强劲需求转化为实际部署，让客户能够获得外部资本来支付新计算能力的巨额前期成本。

但博通在这些销售的同时也承担着风险。 根据其披露的保障安排，如果客户违约，该公司可能需要支付客户租赁付款。
